editorNote: This week keeps one eye on cartridge publishers after Atari’s December warning and another on the computer counter, where Apple IIe, Commodore 64, Atari, and IBM PC software all compete for post-holiday attention.
morningLine: Game cartridges still draw the biggest crowd, but the serious money at the counter increasingly asks about keyboards, disks, printers, and software boxes.

lead.headline: Imagic Stock Delay Shows the Cartridge Boom Losing Its Shine
